newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Matutano, Chipita open Portugal croissant factory.
newsitem.headline: Matutano, Chipita open Portugal croissant factory.

text.p: Matutano, a subsidiary of PepsiCo Foods International, and Greece's Chipita International SA said they were investing 800 million escudos ($5.2 million) to open a croissant factory in Portugal.

The two companies expect the factory, which is based just north of Lisbon and will begin production on Monday, to generate sales of one billion escudos initially, rising to three billion in the medium term.
Matutano will hold 60 percent of the capital and Chipita the remaining 40 percent.
